description: This file defines a 'Home' page component for a furniture shopping app, built with LightningJS. It includes component imports, defines a Lightning component with template, state, watchers, subscriptions, and initialization logic, rendering a header, list of product cards, floating button, and checkout modal.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing the home page of the furniture shopping app with product grid, header, cart button, and checkout modal.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Initializes reactive state properties for UI layout, loading/error states, product list, and modal visibility.

methods.name: watchers
methods.description: Defines reactive watchers for adjusting layout when window size changes and updating UI in response to store state changes.

methods.name: subscriptions
methods.description: Subscribes to global store updates to synchronize products, loading, error, and checkout state.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Performs component initialization, adjusting layout based on initial dimensions and loading product data if necessary.
